Renova Strategic Recommendations

1. OxyHealthCare is the #1 Threat

With 75 active ads, OxyHealthCare dominates share of voice at 46% of the market. Check every ad in Hooks & Copy to map their messaging strategy.

2. Go Video or Go Home

Video is 67% of all ads. The algorithm rewards video with cheaper CPMs. Priority: 3–5 short-form videos — testimonials, treatment walkthroughs, before/after outcomes.

3. Test Carousel for Education-First Messaging

Carousel is 17% of ads. Works well for "5 conditions HBOT helps", "What happens inside the chamber", "Your first session explained".

4. Find Your Differentiation Angle

With 44 competitors running ads, generic messaging won't cut through. Study Hooks & Copy for gaps. Angles worth owning: post-surgery recovery, sports performance, cognitive/mental health benefits.

5. Reverse-Engineer the Longest-Running Ads

Top longevity ads have been running for over 15.2 months. Anything alive after 6+ months has proven ROI. Copy the structure, not the content.

6. Own Hyper-Local Targeting

Many competitors run broad UK targeting. Renova can dominate hyper-local — specific location in creative, geo-targeting a tight radius. Local specificity drives trust and lower CPL in health verticals.

7. Pre-Handle Objections in Creative

HBOT is unfamiliar to most consumers. Top performers pre-handle objections in copy: "You stay fully clothed", "No needles, no surgery", "Approved by medical professionals". Repeated objection language = it's converting.
